questions.question: At which ground did Knights record their 'Largest Win by Runs' (List A)?
questions.explanation: It was at Bloemfontein Oval — largest win by runs of 371, against Kei on 2018/11/24.

questions.question: Who was the first South African woman to take a five-wicket haul in a T20I, achieving the feat before Shabnim Ismail became the second in 2018?
questions.explanation: Ismail's 5 for 30 against India in February 2018 made her the second South African to take a T20I five-wicket haul, after Sune Luus.

questions.question: At which ground did Hlumelo Mati record their career-best bowling figures (2-1, List A)?
questions.explanation: It was at Bloemfontein Oval, against Knights on 2015/10/17.

questions.question: In head-to-head List A meetings, who has the edge, Boland or Warriors?
At Potchefstroom Oval, who holds the record for 'Most Matches' (T20)?
questions.explanation: Nthabiseng Nini holds it with 15, a joint record shared with Lizri de Villiers.

questions.question: How many catches separate the all-time #1 (Nondumiso Shangase) and #2 (Tatum le Roux) fielders (T20)?
questions.explanation: Nondumiso Shangase: 29 — Tatum le Roux: 23 — a gap of 6.
